title.suggested: Tom Allen's Free Concerts at 619 Market Street

summary.suggested: A notice in the St. Louis Globe-Democrat advertised Tom Allen, retired champion pugilist of the world, at 619 Market Street, with a free concert every evening and only the best singers engaged.
